as_told.title: Ben Rich UCLA speech: 'take ET home'

plain: Ben Rich, an aerospace engineer who led secret aircraft work, is said to have told an audience: "We now have the technology to take ET home." Michels repeats the line in two episodes; in one he simply quotes it, and in the other he says Rich used it to close a talk at UCLA in 1993 and that several people who were there remember it. It is told because, coming from someone inside secret aircraft development, it would suggest the US had technology able to travel to other worlds.
